lst.err.line: One row error of a CSV list: the line number in the file and the reason; {line} = line, {text} = the reason.
lst.user.added: Message after a CSV was added as a list; {name} = the list name, {n} = number of ions.
lst.user.skipped: Message after importing a CSV with wrong rows; {n} = number of rows left out.
lst.add.errs: Heading of the list of row errors found in a CSV the person added as a list; {n} = number of rows with errors.
lst.add.importValid: Button that adds the valid rows of a CSV that also has wrong rows; {n} = number of valid rows.
lst.info.count: Coverage of a reference list: {n} = number of ions (rows of the table), {m} = number of compounds they come from.
lst.info.classes: Coverage of a reference list: number of chemical classes; {n} = number.
lst.info.source: Source line of a built-in list; {source} = the bibliographic reference.
lst.info.file: Name of the file a user list was read from; {file} = file name.
